_brief: Batch 2026-10-03 item 9, Kindness Tests: Shop owner 7 (Muhammad, a bread cart in the Old City). V1. One camera (chest cam POV, 9:16). The shortest of the set: ASK -> THE YES -> reveal, refused twice, then he takes it -> why Tal insists (give bread for free to other people) -> Muslim / Jewish / brothers on his face. NO ZOOMS: every beat is the full frame. No slow motion: there is no wordless reaction in the clip to put it on (he talks or Tal talks throughout).
_left_out: 71-91s a passer-by vouches for him ("He's the best guy in the world ... not only you, anybody ... he's number one"). The words are good; the picture is Tal's phone held up in the middle of the frame and the man 8 metres away, so it is not in the cut. 66-68s "kulo wahad": large-v3 hears "All together", turbo "Kula wahad", cached "All of a one" - not agreed, so the beat ends before it.
beats: THE ASK, already at the bread cart: "I'm sorry, but I don't have money. Can you help me, please, with one piece of bread?" - his hand is already holding one out
THE YES: "Please, I don't have money" "You want one?" "Yeah, please. I'm just hungry" - the bread goes into the bag
REVEAL + REFUSAL, one take (10.1s): "Actually, this is for you" "No, it's okay" "For you?" "No, for you" "No, thanks" ... "For you" "Take it" - he refuses twice, smiling, the note in Tal's hand
WHY TAL INSISTS: "I want you to give bread for free to other people" - the kindness is passed on through him
WHO THEY ARE, on his face, the handshake: "You are Muslim?" "Yes" "I'm Jewish. We are brothers" ... "Muslims and Jews, we are all the same"
